evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Current multi-view observations form 3D patch-token working memory, while prior observations and interactions persist as spatial-temporal episodic features.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Working-memory tokens query episodic memory through attention and fuse task-relevant spatial and temporal features.

When the agent moves to a new environment, the preceding working memory is transferred into episodic memory. For 3DLLM-Mem, this specifically supports migration between memory tiers of working memory and episodic memory.

If a previously represented environment is revisited after modification, the corresponding memory entry is updated to the latest observed state. For 3DLLM-Mem, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of working memory and episodic memory.

derived.hybrid_relation: Working and episodic levels contain the same modality-native 3D feature type.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): During inference, the operative memory component (working memory and episodic memory) changes through migration between memory tiers, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
